clue.text: Moral code followed by a student

parts.note: an ethic is a moral code or set of principles
L is a learner, as on a learner driver's L-plate

explanation.surface: A rulebook of conduct is followed by some pupil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Moral code' looks like one phrase, but 'Moral' alone is the definition and 'code' starts the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe conduct that follows principles of right and wrong; synonyms as adjectives.

clue.text: Finished, being nothing less than painstaking

indicators.note: less than means the word for painstaking loses something, here the letter for nothing

parts.note: painstaking work is thorough
O, the round figure zero, stands for nothing

explanation.surface: Someone is done because they were utterly careful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nothing less than' reads as an intensifier, but it says remove O (nothing) from THOROUGH.
explanation.definitionFit: To be through with a task is to have completed it, so finished is a synonym.

clue.text: Outgoing children

definitions.meaning: an outflow or emergence, as of water issuing from a spring

explanation.definitionFit: Issue means both an outflow and a person's offspring, two separate dictionary senses.

clue.text: A stubborn worker seen around river vessel

indicators.note: the worker word is placed around the river, enclosing it

parts.note: a mule is a proverbially stubborn beast of burden
the Po is Italy's longest river

explanation.surface: An obstinate labourer is spotted near a waterway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seen' is only a link word; 'around' is the container signal, and 'vessel' is a container for liquid rather than a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: An ampoule is a small sealed glass container for a liquid, a kind of vessel.

clue.text: Travel over snow is accepted by some retired people

indicators.note: being accepted by something means being taken inside it
retired means drawn back, so the word some is read backwards

parts.note: taken as written before reversing
to ski is to travel over snow

explanation.surface: Skiing is enjoyed by a few pensioners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retired' looks like it describes the pensioners, but it is the reversal signal, giving EMOS; 'is accepted by' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The Eskimos are Arctic peoples of Greenland, Canada, Alaska and Siberia, so the word names a people.

clue.text: Companion of Snow White likely to crash?

definitions.meaning: one of the seven dwarfs in the Disney film
crash is slang for falling asleep, so drowsy

explanation.definitionFit: Sleepy is one of the seven dwarfs and also means ready to drop off to sleep.

clue.text: Pregnant member of society

definitions.meaning: a British slang phrase for expecting a baby
belonging to a club or society, taken literally

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is British slang for expecting a baby and literally means belonging to a club.

clue.text: The excessive utilisation of various oeuvres

indicators.note: various suggests the letters of oeuvres in differing arrangements

explanation.surface: Too much use is made of several artistic works.
explanation.definitionFit: Overuse as a noun is using something too much, so excessive utilisation is a direct paraphrase.

clue.text: Declare all points in order

parts.note: reads like a debater listing arguments, but means reciting the points of a navigator's dial in sequence

explanation.walkthrough: To box the compass is to name all thirty-two compass points in order; figuratively, to go all the way round.
explanation.definitionFit: The nautical idiom means reciting every compass point in sequence, which matches declaring all points in order.

clue.text: Girl is to accept religious instruction

indicators.note: accepting something means taking it in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: taken as written
RI is the abbreviation for religious instruction, a school subject

explanation.surface: A young woman is to take a scripture class.
explanation.definitionFit: Iris is a girl's name, a usual crossword way of defining a forename.

clue.text: Building constructed with joints in natural colouring

definitions.note: the definition is singular while the answer is plural; buildings as real estate are properties

parts.note: in heraldry, proper means shown in its natural colours
ties are joints or connections, as in a tie-beam or railway ties

explanation.surface: A structure is put up using joins in a natural shade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'constructed with' and 'in' are link words. PROPER is the heraldic term for a charge shown in natural colours.
explanation.definitionFit: Properties are buildings or land held as real estate, so building is a looser, singular synonym.

clue.text: Office desk

definitions.meaning: an agency or department, such as an information office

explanation.definitionFit: A bureau is both a government or business office and a type of writing desk.

clue.text: Maintained a high level

parts.note: reads as sustaining a high standard, but describes refilling a container to the brim

explanation.walkthrough: Topped up means refilled, keeping the level of a glass or tank high.
explanation.definitionFit: Refilling something keeps its contents at a high level, the literal sense of the phrasal verb.

clue.text: Three-card trick has been given a licence

indicators.note: a trick plays with the letters, rearranging them

explanation.surface: A card-sharp's three-card game has been officially licensed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Three-card trick' looks like the con game; 'trick' is the anagram signal on THREECARD.
explanation.definitionFit: Chartered means granted a charter, an official licence or right to operate.

clue.text: Frier paid off with speedy discharge

indicators.note: off means out of order or awry, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fryer pays off, maybe with a quick release of grease.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapid-fire describes shots discharged in quick succession, so speedy discharge fits.

clue.text: Navy prison

explanation.definitionFit: A fleet is a navy's ships, and the Fleet was a notorious London prison by the River Fleet.

clue.text: Female undergarments, possibly bloomers

definitions.meaning: bloomers is British slang for blunders, so mistakes

explanation.definitionFit: Slips are both women's underskirts and small errors, which bloomers also means.

clue.text: Permit excessive behaviour?

definitions.meaning: freedom abused, as in poetic or sexual ...

explanation.definitionFit: A licence is a permit and also unrestrained, excessive freedom of conduct.

clue.text: Mistress has care of one whelp among nine

parts.note: c/o, written CO, is the address abbreviation for care of

indicators.note: among puts the young animal inside the number word

parts.note: taken as written
a cub is a whelp, a young animal

explanation.surface: A mistress looks after one puppy out of nine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one' just means 'a' here, so it gives no letters; 'among' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A concubine is a woman kept as a mistress, an old-fashioned near-synonym.

clue.text: Full of humanity

parts.note: sounds like being kind-hearted, but means packed with people

explanation.walkthrough: Humanity means people in bulk, not compassion.
explanation.definitionFit: A place packed tight with people is full of humanity in the literal sense.

clue.text: Wants to be out of the French sewers

indicators.note: one word stands outside the other, so it wraps around it

parts.note: needs means wants or lacks
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Demand to leave the Gallic drains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sewers' looks like drains; it means things that sew. 'to be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Needles are tools that sew, so they are sewers in the sense of stitchers.

clue.text: Saw the head for an examination

definitions.text: Saw the head for an examination

parts.words: Saw the head for an examination
parts.note: reads as visiting a headteacher, but means cutting into a skull surgically

explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like the past of see; it is the verb to saw.
explanation.definitionFit: To trepan is to bore a hole in the skull with a surgical saw, as for examination.

clue.text: Bitter sweet

parts.note: looks like the word for mixed feelings, but means a sour-tasting confection

explanation.walkthrough: An ACID DROP is a sharp-tasting British boiled sweet.
explanation.definitionFit: This boiled confection tastes sharp and sour, so it is a sour candy.

clue.text: An actor not working? Provide compensation!

definitions.meaning: a performer who is away from the film set
to balance one thing against another

explanation.definitionFit: Offset means to counterbalance, and read as two words describes an actor off the set.

clue.text: We infer a reduction in numbers

definitions.text: We infer a reduction in numbers

parts.words: We infer a reduction in numbers
parts.note: read 'infer' as in FER: the word we is placed in those letters, giving a word for not as many

explanation.walkthrough: A cryptic hint: split 'infer' as 'in FER' and put WE inside to make a word meaning not as many.
explanation.definitionFit: The word compares quantities as smaller, so implies a reduction in numbers.

clue.text: Ordered home before becoming unwell

indicators.note: before places the home word ahead of the other piece

parts.note: in means at home
disposed means arranged or set in order

explanation.surface: Told to go home before falling ill.
explanation.definitionFit: Indisposed is a formal synonym for slightly ill.

clue.text: Fit a spring

definitions.meaning: a source of water from the ground

explanation.definitionFit: Well means in good health, and a well is a water source like a spring.

clue.text: Send me round to eastern land

indicators.note: round suggests turning the letters about into a new order

explanation.surface: Dispatch me back to the east country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' is the anagram signal, giving DEMESN; 'to' joins on the final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A demesne is land held by a lord for his own use, an estate.

clue.text: Lecture put on at short notice

parts.note: ad is short for advertisement, a notice
to dress is to put clothes on

explanation.surface: A talk is arranged at the last minute.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at short notice' looks like haste; 'at' is a link and 'short notice' is AD.
explanation.definitionFit: An address is a formal speech, so lecture is a synonym.
